inputs.prompt: A SEAMLESS TILEABLE texture seen straight from above (top-down, orthographic), uniform density everywhere, no focal point, no large objects, no shadows of objects, even flat lighting; the left edge continues seamlessly into the right edge and the top into the bottom.
